body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). The fleet flail, linked-worktree, and lock-recovery test suites (flail-contract.test.mjs, flail-e2e.test.mjs, linked-worktree.test.mjs, lock-recovery.test.mjs) manually invoke mkdtempSync and manage fixture cleanups via manual try/finally or leave fixture directories unremoved, and are allowlisted in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs. With @adlc/core/test-kit (tmp), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via t.after when passed the test context t.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In packages/fleet/test/flail-contract.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update makeLog(t, content) helper to accept t and allocate directory via tmp(t, 'fleet-flail-').
   - Update test declarations to accept t from test(...) and pass to makeLog or allocate directly via tmp(t, 'fleet-flail-').
2. In packages/fleet/test/flail-e2e.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update test declarations creating temp directories to accept t from test(...).
   - Replace mkdtempSync calls with tmp(t, 'fleet-e2e-') and tmp(t, 'fleet-e2e-git-').
3. In packages/fleet/test/linked-worktree.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update fixture(t) helper to accept t and allocate root via tmp(t, 'fleet-linked-').
   - Update tests to pass t to fixture(t) and allocate root via tmp(t, 'fleet-linked-link-').
   - Remove manual try/finally blocks calling rmSync(root, ...), unindenting test bodies.
4. In packages/fleet/test/lock-recovery.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp as makeTmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update tmp(t) helper to accept t and delegate to makeTmp(t, 'fleet-lock-').
   - Update test declarations calling tmp() to accept t and pass t to tmp(t).
5. In scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs:
   - Remove 'packages/fleet/test/flail-contract.test.mjs', 'packages/fleet/test/flail-e2e.test.mjs', 'packages/fleet/test/linked-worktree.test.mjs', and 'packages/fleet/test/lock-recovery.test.mjs' from the ALLOWLIST set.
6. Verification:
   - node --test packages/fleet/test/flail-contract.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/flail-e2e.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/linked-worktree.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/lock-recovery.test.mjs exits 0.
   - node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
   - grep -c 'finally' packages/fleet/test/flail-contract.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/flail-e2e.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/linked-worktree.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/lock-recovery.test.mjs outputs 0, 0, 0, 0.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 packages/fleet/test/flail-contract.test.mjs, flail-e2e.test.mjs, linked-worktree.test.mjs, and lock-recovery.test.mjs contain 0 finally blocks.
- AC2 mkdtempSync is not called in any of the 4 test files.
- AC3 None of the 4 test files appear in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs ALLOWLIST.
- AC4 node --test packages/fleet/test/flail-contract.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/flail-e2e.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/linked-worktree.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/lock-recovery.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC5 node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC6 adlc rails-guard exits 0.
title: refactor(fleet): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit in flail, worktree, and lock tests
